sql_query.description: SQL query that should be executed on the provided database.

db_uri.description: SQLAlchemy connection URI of the PostgreSQL database, e.g. postgresql+psycopg2://user:password@host:5432/database. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.

read_only.description: When true (the default), only SELECT queries are allowed. Set this in the tool configuration, not by the agent — the agent never sees or sets this value.
